case_title: Mst. Aisha Bibi v. Muhammad Aslam
text: Suit for partition of joint ancestral land. Under Section 44 of the Transfer of Property Act 1882, a transferee from one of several co-owners of an undivided immovable property acquires only the rights of transferor and is entitled to joint possession only subject to the conditions and liabilities affecting the share. He cannot claim possession of a specific khasra number prior to final decree in partition.
